label: A being at w whose existence no essential truth entails is absent at some accessible world
paraphrase: OPEN (essentialist account of possibility of absence, the non-power ground of de re possibility, ACT-06; analyst formulation): every being x existing at w such that no essential truth of any being entails x's existence (holds only at points where x exists) is absent at some world accessible from w. Possibility of absence is the absence of an essential exclusion.
